provenance.source_section: Experiment 1: Fraunhofer diffraction of single slit; Examples of Data Recording and Processing
provenance.transcription_note: All 63 X/current pairs are transcribed as printed. The irregular positions 17.1 mm and 34.9 mm are preserved exactly; no interpolation or resampling was applied.

setup.distance_derivation: Z=511-7=504 mm, as stated in the manual
setup.wavelength_status: value used in the manual example calculation; not an independently recorded per-run wavelength measurement
setup.measurement_quantity: photocell current reading in instrument units, not calibrated irradiance

limitations: The manual does not specify the photocell active aperture; spatial averaging cannot be parameterized from the source.
Photocell readings are not traceably calibrated irradiance.
650 nm is used as the manual example value, not a per-run measured wavelength.
A single scan does not establish repeatability or measurement uncertainty.
The ideal scalar Fraunhofer model excludes alignment error, detector-aperture convolution, source spectral width and background drift.
